rationale: Repair the existing Rendering Exit Safety contract so it can exact-preserve customer-facing response section types already authorized by the Response Assembler contract: EDUCATION, EXAMPLE, PRACTICAL_ILLUSTRATION, CUSTOMER_QUALIFICATION, CUSTOMER_EXPLANATION, and NEXT_STEP. Product integration exposed that project_render_envelope copies response section types directly into render units while the rendering contract still contained only the older section vocabulary.
supersession_impact: No capability is superseded and no historical response meaning is reinterpreted. Rendering Exit Safety continues to enforce exact preservation, required-unit completeness, set/order equality, and fail-closed conformance; the repair only aligns its accepted unit vocabulary with already-existing customer response section types.
authority_impact: No insurance, claim, coverage, payment, recommendation, publication, or interpretation authority is added. The newly accepted unit types are already valid Response Assembler section types and remain subject to the same PRESERVE_EXACT rendering policy.
